dslRule:
<!id: junit.assertThatIsToAssertEquals>
<!description: Replace Hamcrest assertThat(actual, is(expected)) with JUnit assertEquals(expected, actual).>
<!severity: WARNING>

org.hamcrest.MatcherAssert.assertThat($actual, org.hamcrest.CoreMatchers.is($expected))
=>
org.junit.Assert.assertEquals($expected, $actual)
;;
summary: Replaces Hamcrest `assertThat($actual, is($expected))` with JUnit `assertEquals($expected, $actual)` to simplify assertions and improve error messages.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
